title.en: From geocentrism to the geocentric frame
title.zh: 从地心说到地心参考系

summary.en: See why an Earth-centered model could predict the sky, why heliocentric dynamics explains the system more simply, and why modern astronomy still uses geocentric coordinates.
summary.zh: 理解地心模型为何能预测天空、日心动力学为何更简洁，以及现代天文学为何仍使用地心坐标。

boundary.en: Solar Atlas subtracts Earth’s propagated position. It does not reconstruct Ptolemy’s deferent–epicycle–eccentric–equant system, a rotating Earth-fixed frame, or the relativistic GCRS. These Earth-centered tracks are a modern coordinate translation—not evidence that Earth is stationary or dynamically central.
boundary.zh: Solar Atlas 只是减去传播得到的地球位置，并不重建托勒密的均轮—本轮—偏心圆—偏心匀速点体系、随地球自转的固连坐标系或相对论性的 GCRS。这里的地心轨迹是现代坐标平移，不是地球静止或处于动力学中心的证据。

sources.label: Library of Congress: Ancient Greek astronomy and the Ptolemaic model
NASA: Planetary motion and the scientific revolution
IAU Resolution B1: Geocentric reference systems and frames

definition.en: A physical model that treats a stationary Earth as the center around which celestial motions are organized.
definition.zh: 把静止地球视为中心，并围绕它组织天体运动的物理模型。

definition.en: A coordinate system whose origin is Earth’s center; choosing it does not assert that Earth is stationary or physically central.
definition.zh: 以地球中心为原点的坐标系；选择它不代表地球静止或处于物理中心。

definition.en: A small circle whose center moves on a larger deferent in historical planetary models.
definition.zh: 历史行星模型中的小圆，其圆心沿更大的均轮运动。

question.en: When modern astronomers use Earth-centered coordinates, are they endorsing the historical claim that Earth is stationary at the physical center?
question.zh: 现代天文学使用地心坐标时，是否等于认同地球静止在物理中心的历史主张？

text.en: Yes—the coordinate origin determines the physical center
text.zh: 是——坐标原点决定物理中心

text.en: No—the frame is a coordinate choice; the dynamical model still includes Earth’s motion
text.zh: 否——参考系只是坐标选择，动力学模型仍包含地球的运动

explanation.en: A geocentric frame is indispensable for many Earth-relative measurements, but it does not revive a stationary-Earth dynamical theory.
explanation.zh: 地心参考系对许多相对地球的测量不可或缺，但它不会让“地球静止”的动力学理论重新成立。

title.en: Why did an Earth-centered cosmos feel natural?
title.zh: 为什么地心宇宙如此自然？

prompt.en: Put Earth at the origin and follow the Sun, Venus, Mars, and Jupiter over two years.
prompt.zh: 把地球放在原点，追踪太阳、金星、火星和木星两年的相对运动。

body.en: Observers measure the sky from Earth, so an Earth-centered description begins with the question they can directly ask: where is each object relative to us? The resulting loops make geocentrism intuitively compelling even though intuition alone cannot identify the physical center.
body.zh: 观测者从地球测量天空，因此地心描述从一个可直接回答的问题出发：每个天体相对我们在哪里？这些回环让地心说非常符合直觉，但直觉本身不能判定物理中心。

prompt.en: Look at the different loops and ask what a table-maker would need to reproduce their timing and size.
prompt.zh: 观察不同回环，并思考制表者需要怎样复现它们的时序与尺度。

body.en: Ptolemy combined deferents, epicycles, eccentric circles, and an equant into a sophisticated predictive system. Solar Atlas does not draw that historical machinery; these translated tracks expose the observational pattern it was built to fit. Its success was not mere ignorance—it was a model with real predictive power and growing complexity.
body.zh: 托勒密把均轮、本轮、偏心圆和偏心匀速点组合成复杂的预测体系。Solar Atlas 不绘制这套历史机械；这里的平移轨迹只是展示它试图拟合的观测图样。它的成功并非单纯无知，而是源于真实预测能力以及不断增长的复杂度。

prompt.en: Keep the date and planets fixed, then move the origin from Earth to the Sun.
prompt.zh: 保持日期和天体集合不变，把原点从地球移到太阳。

body.en: The nested planetary architecture becomes compact, and Earth appears as another moving planet. In this description, Mars’s retrograde loop follows from Earth overtaking it rather than from Mars reversing or riding a dedicated epicycle.
body.zh: 行星的嵌套结构变得简洁，地球也成为一颗运动的行星。在这种描述中，火星逆行来自地球超越火星，而不是火星反向运动或沿专门的本轮运行。

title.en: A coordinate frame is not a theory of nature

prompt.en: Open the split Earth- and Sun-centered views of the same propagated state.
prompt.zh: 打开同一传播状态的地心与日心分屏视图。

body.en: Either origin can describe the geometry. A physical theory makes additional claims about motion, forces, and what should be observed. Historical geocentrism asserted a stationary, central Earth; a modern geocentric frame makes no such assertion.
body.zh: 两个原点都能描述几何。物理理论还必须对运动、力和可观测结果作出额外主张；历史地心说断言地球静止且居中，而现代地心参考系没有这种断言。

prompt.en: Ask what evidence must distinguish models that can both be drawn to match planetary positions.
prompt.zh: 思考：当两种模型都能调整到匹配行星位置时，什么证据能够区分它们？

body.en: Galileo’s full range of Venus phases contradicted the classical Ptolemaic arrangement, Jupiter’s moons showed that not everything circles Earth, Kepler’s ellipses improved predictions, and Newtonian gravity unified the dynamics. The atlas scene illustrates the geometry; the linked evidence establishes why a stationary-Earth physical model was rejected.
body.zh: 伽利略观测到的金星完整相位序列与经典托勒密结构冲突，木星卫星表明并非一切都绕地球，开普勒椭圆提高了预测精度，牛顿引力则统一了解释。图谱场景展示几何，所链接的证据说明为何“地球静止”的物理模型被淘汰。

title.en: Modern astronomy still needs Earth at the origin
title.zh: 现代天文学仍需要把地球放在原点

prompt.en: Return to Earth-centered coordinates and name tasks that are naturally Earth-relative.
prompt.zh: 回到地心坐标，列举天然以地球为参照的任务。

body.en: Satellite tracking, Earth orientation, telescope pointing, geodesy, and space navigation all use precise geocentric systems such as the IAU GCRS. Solar Atlas’s simpler translated ecliptic frame is not GCRS, but it teaches the same key distinction: Earth can be the most useful origin without being the stationary center of the Solar System.
body.zh: 卫星跟踪、地球定向、望远镜指向、大地测量和空间导航都会使用 IAU GCRS 等精密地心系统。Solar Atlas 的黄道平移坐标远比 GCRS 简化，但它揭示同一个关键区别：地球可以是最有用的原点，却不是太阳系静止的物理中心。

summary.en: Switch between heliocentric and geocentric frames as Earth overtakes Mars.
summary.zh: 在地心与日心参考系间切换，观察地球超越火星时的视运动。

boundary.en: The paths use approximate planetary elements. The loop is a coordinate effect; this view does not model topocentric observing conditions or atmospheric refraction.
boundary.zh: 轨迹使用行星近似根数。回环是坐标效应；本视图不模拟地表观测位置或大气折射。

definition.en: A chosen origin and coordinate system used to describe the same physical positions.
definition.zh: 用于描述同一组物理位置的原点与坐标选择。

definition.en: An outer planet appears opposite the Sun in Earth’s sky.
definition.zh: 外行星在地球天空中看起来位于太阳的相反方向。

question.en: During apparent retrograde motion, does Mars reverse its direction around the Sun?
question.zh: 视逆行期间，火星是否会反转绕太阳公转的方向？

explanation.en: The loop appears only after Earth’s faster motion is subtracted from the scene.
explanation.zh: 只有从场景中减去地球更快的运动后，回环才会出现。

prompt.en: Open the Sun-centered scene and compare the directions of Earth and Mars over the same interval.
prompt.zh: 打开日心场景，在同一时间段比较地球与火星的运动方向。

body.en: Both planets continue prograde around the Sun. Mars never reverses its heliocentric velocity during the apparent retrograde loop.
body.zh: 两颗行星始终沿同一公转方向绕太阳运行；视逆行期间，火星的日心速度从未反向。

prompt.en: Notice which planet covers more orbital longitude during the trajectory window.
prompt.zh: 观察在轨迹时间窗内，哪颗行星扫过的轨道经度更多。

body.en: Earth has the shorter period and gains longitude on Mars. Near opposition, Earth passes between the Sun and Mars.
body.zh: 地球周期更短，会逐渐追上火星；冲日前后，地球从太阳与火星之间超过火星。

prompt.en: Switch to the Earth-centered frame and look for the temporary loop in Mars’s path.
prompt.zh: 切换到地心参考系，寻找火星轨迹中的短暂回环。

body.en: Subtracting Earth’s motion from both bodies changes the apparent path. The loop appears because the observer is moving on the faster inner orbit.
body.zh: 从所有位置中减去地球运动会改变视轨迹；观测者位于更快的内侧轨道上，因此出现回环。

prompt.en: Compare the heliocentric and geocentric scenes without changing the date.
prompt.zh: 保持日期不变，对比日心与地心场景。

body.en: A reference frame changes coordinates, not the physical event. Retrograde motion is an apparent angular reversal on the observer’s sky.
body.zh: 参考系改变的是坐标而非物理事件；逆行是观测者天空中的视角方向反转。

title.en: Keep the date and data fixed

prompt.en: Use split comparison to inspect Sun- and Earth-centered views of the same propagated positions.
prompt.zh: 使用分屏对比同一组传播位置的日心与地心视图。

body.en: The reproducible scene records the epoch, selected bodies, frame, and data version, so only the coordinate description changes.
body.zh: 可复现场景记录历元、天体集合、参考系与数据版本，因此改变的只有坐标描述。

title.en: From a diagram to an observation

prompt.en: List what a sky observer would still need beyond this ecliptic trajectory view.
prompt.zh: 列出真实天空观测在黄道轨迹图之外还需要的信息。

body.en: Topocentric location, light-time, aberration, precession, and atmospheric refraction are outside this teaching scene; use an observing ephemeris for measured sky coordinates.
body.zh: 地表位置、光行时、光行差、岁差与大气折射均不在本教学场景中；实测天空坐标应使用观测星历。

title.zh: 同一太阳系，多种参考系

summary.en: Compare Sun-, Earth-, and Jupiter-centered descriptions of the same instant.
summary.zh: 对比同一时刻在日心、地心与木星中心坐标中的描述。

boundary.en: These are translated coordinate frames, not rotating dynamical frames. Fictitious forces are not integrated or displayed.
boundary.zh: 这些视图是平移后的坐标系，而非旋转动力学系；不会积分或显示惯性力。

definition.en: Subtracting the same origin position from every plotted body.
definition.zh: 从每个绘制天体的位置中减去同一个原点位置。

definition.en: A quantity, such as pairwise distance, that is unchanged by the coordinate translation.
definition.zh: 在坐标平移后仍保持不变的量，例如两天体间距离。

question.en: When the origin moves from the Sun to Earth, does the Earth–Mars distance change?
question.zh: 原点从太阳移到地球时，地球—火星距离会改变吗？

explanation.en: Translating every position changes plotted coordinates but preserves pairwise separation.
explanation.zh: 对所有位置做同一平移会改变绘图坐标，但保持两两间距。

prompt.en: Start with the Sun at the origin and identify the large-scale orbital ordering.
prompt.zh: 先把太阳放在原点，辨认太阳系的大尺度轨道次序。

body.en: The heliocentric frame makes the broad architecture compact: nested planetary orbits surround the dominant mass.
body.zh: 日心参考系让整体结构最清晰：行星轨道围绕占主导质量的太阳层层嵌套。

prompt.en: Look for loops and cusps that were absent from the Sun-centered tracks.
prompt.zh: 寻找日心轨迹中没有的回环与尖点。

body.en: The same positions become observer-relative tracks when Earth’s position is subtracted. Inner and outer planets acquire different apparent patterns.
body.zh: 减去地球位置后，同一组位置成为相对观测轨迹；内行星与外行星呈现不同视运动。

prompt.en: Change the origin again and compare the scale of Jupiter’s motion with the inner planets.
prompt.zh: 再次改变原点，比较木星与内行星相对运动的尺度。

body.en: A body-centered view is useful for local geometry, but it does not imply that every visible object is gravitationally bound to the reference body.
body.zh: 天体中心视图适合观察局部几何，但并不意味着画面中的每个对象都受该参考天体束缚。

prompt.en: Return to the Sun while keeping the same instant and selected bodies.
prompt.zh: 保持时刻和天体集合不变，再回到日心系。

body.en: Distances between bodies are invariant under this translation even though every plotted path changes shape.
body.zh: 平移参考系会改变每条绘制轨迹的形状，但天体之间的距离保持不变。

prompt.en: Use the distance ribbon in two different frames and compare its value at the same Julian Day.
prompt.zh: 在两个不同参考系中使用距离条，比较同一儒略日的数值。

body.en: The atlas resolves both bodies before translating the frame, so the measured separation is identical up to displayed rounding.
body.zh: 图谱先求出两个天体的位置再平移参考系，因此测得间距除显示舍入外完全一致。

title.en: A translated frame is not a rotating dynamics model
title.zh: 平移参考系不是旋转动力学模型

prompt.en: Ask which fictitious forces would appear in a genuinely rotating frame.
prompt.zh: 思考真正旋转参考系中会出现哪些惯性力。

body.en: These views translate the origin but do not integrate Coriolis or centrifugal terms. They describe geometry, not a new force model.
body.zh: 这些视图只平移原点，不会积分科里奥利力或离心力项；它们描述几何，而不是新的力学模型。

title.zh: 木星刻出的柯克伍德空隙

summary.en: Read resonances as missing density in semi-major-axis space.
summary.zh: 在半长轴分布中，把平均运动共振读成密度缺口。

boundary.en: The atlas displays the observed MPCORB distribution and resonance locations. Its two-body propagation does not dynamically excavate the gaps.
boundary.zh: 图谱展示观测到的 MPCORB 分布与共振位置；二体传播本身不会动态形成这些空隙。

definition.en: An orbital-period relationship close to a ratio of small integers.
definition.zh: 轨道周期接近小整数比的关系。

definition.en: The instantaneous Keplerian ellipse tangent to a perturbed orbit at an epoch.
definition.zh: 在某历元与受摄轨道相切的瞬时开普勒椭圆。

question.en: Does Solar Atlas’s two-body propagation dynamically create the Kirkwood gaps?
question.zh: Solar Atlas 的二体传播会动态形成柯克伍德空隙吗？

text.en: No, it displays the observed distribution

explanation.en: Long-term depletion needs planetary perturbations; the atlas overlays resonance locations on MPCORB observations.
explanation.zh: 长期清空需要行星摄动；图谱是在 MPCORB 观测分布上叠加共振位置。

prompt.en: Open a–e element space and scan the main-belt density from 2 to 3.5 AU.
prompt.zh: 打开 a–e 元素空间，观察 2–3.5 AU 的主带密度。

body.en: The belt is structured. Narrow low-density bands interrupt the otherwise dense population.
body.zh: 主带具有明显结构；在高密度分布中，若干狭窄低密度带贯穿其中。

prompt.en: Compare the vertical resonance guides near 2.50 and 2.82 AU with the point density.
prompt.zh: 把 2.50 与 2.82 AU 附近的竖直共振标线同点密度比较。

body.en: These labels mean an asteroid completes roughly three or five revolutions while Jupiter completes one or two. Repeated perturbations destabilize parts of phase space.
body.zh: 这些比例表示小行星与木星在相同时间内完成近似整数圈数；重复摄动会使部分相空间失稳。

prompt.en: Widen the interval and compare the gaps near 2.96 and 3.28 AU across inclination.
prompt.zh: 扩大范围，在不同倾角上比较 2.96 与 3.28 AU 附近的缺口。

body.en: The gaps persist across much of the plotted inclination range, showing that semi-major-axis resonance—not display color—is organizing the structure.
body.zh: 缺口跨越较大的倾角范围，说明组织结构的是半长轴共振，而不是显示颜色。

prompt.en: Switch among a–e, a–i, and a–period while keeping the same main-belt filter.
prompt.zh: 保持同一主带筛选，在 a–e、a–i 与 a–周期图之间切换。

body.en: A feature aligned with semi-major axis across several projections is less likely to be a plotting artifact. Exact counts remain tied to the active immutable dataset.
body.zh: 在多个投影中都沿半长轴对齐的特征不太可能是绘图伪影；精确计数始终绑定当前不可变数据集。

title.en: Distribution is evidence, not an integration
title.zh: 分布是证据，不是积分结果

prompt.en: Ask what this plot directly shows and what requires an N-body model.
prompt.zh: 区分这张图直接显示的证据，以及必须依靠 N-body 模型回答的问题。

body.en: MPCORB supplies today’s osculating population. Explaining long-term depletion rates requires perturbation theory or numerical N-body integrations beyond this fast atlas mode.
body.zh: MPCORB 提供当前密切轨道总体；解释长期清空速率需要摄动理论或数值 N-body 积分，超出快速图谱模式。

title.en: Turn the visual clue into a query

prompt.en: Narrow the semi-major-axis interval around one gap and run an exact catalog scan.
prompt.zh: 把半长轴范围缩小到一个空隙附近，并运行精确目录扫描。

body.en: The point cloud is a bounded sample; the catalog’s explicit exact scan is the appropriate path when a quantitative count matters.
body.zh: 点云是有界样本；需要定量计数时，应使用目录中显式触发的精确扫描。

title.en: Why Trojans gather at L4 and L5
title.zh: 特洛伊群为何聚集在 L4/L5

summary.en: Explore the rotating geometry around Jupiter’s stable triangular points.
summary.zh: 探索木星轨道上稳定三角拉格朗日点周围的旋转几何。

boundary.en: L4/L5 markers use instantaneous circular restricted three-body geometry. The atlas does not integrate Trojan libration or long-term stability.
boundary.zh: L4/L5 标记使用瞬时圆型限制性三体几何；图谱不会积分特洛伊天体的天平动或长期稳定性。

definition.en: Bounded oscillation of a resonant angle around an equilibrium value.
definition.zh: 共振角围绕平衡值进行的有界振荡。

definition.en: Two bodies have nearly the same orbital period around the primary.
definition.zh: 两个天体绕主星的轨道周期几乎相同。

question.en: Does a marker placed 60° from Jupiter prove that a real asteroid is stable for billions of years?
question.zh: 在木星前后 60° 放置一个标记，能证明真实小行星可稳定数十亿年吗？

explanation.en: Long-term stability requires a dynamical model and the asteroid’s resonant-angle history.
explanation.zh: 长期稳定性需要动力学模型以及该小行星的共振角历史。

prompt.en: Turn on Lagrange markers and locate the points 60° ahead of and behind Jupiter.
prompt.zh: 打开拉格朗日点图层，定位木星前后各 60° 的位置。

body.en: In the circular restricted three-body model, L4 and L5 form equilateral configurations with the Sun and Jupiter.
body.zh: 在圆型限制性三体模型中，L4、L5 与太阳、木星构成等边三角形。

prompt.en: Open the catalog with the Jupiter Trojan class and compare its orbital scale with Jupiter.
prompt.zh: 在目录中打开木星特洛伊分类，并把轨道尺度同木星比较。

body.en: Jupiter Trojans have periods near Jupiter’s, so their mean longitudes remain near the two 1:1 resonance islands rather than spreading uniformly.
body.zh: 木星特洛伊天体的周期接近木星，因此平均经度停留在两个 1:1 共振岛附近，而非均匀铺开。

prompt.en: Move several years forward and see the L4/L5 markers rotate with Jupiter.
prompt.zh: 向前移动数年，观察 L4/L5 标记随木星一起转动。

body.en: The markers are recomputed from Jupiter’s instantaneous Sun-centered position. They show the rotating geometry, not individual Trojan integrations.
body.zh: 标记根据木星瞬时日心位置重新计算；它们展示旋转几何，而不是单个特洛伊天体的积分轨迹。

prompt.en: Compare the observed JTA population with the instantaneous L4 and L5 directions.
prompt.zh: 把观测到的 JTA 族群与瞬时 L4、L5 方向比较。

body.en: The catalog classification and angular clustering are observational evidence for co-orbital structure. Individual stability still depends on resonant-angle libration.
body.zh: 目录分类与角度聚集是共轨结构的观测证据；单个天体是否稳定仍取决于共振角天平动。

prompt.en: Decide whether a static L4 marker alone proves that a real asteroid is stable.
prompt.zh: 判断一个静态 L4 标记能否单独证明真实小行星长期稳定。

body.en: It cannot. Stability depends on libration amplitude, eccentricity, inclination, planetary perturbations, and long integrations. This scene is a geometric teaching layer.
body.zh: 不能。稳定性取决于天平动幅度、离心率、倾角、行星摄动与长期积分；本场景只是几何教学层。

title.zh: 检查一条真实特洛伊记录

prompt.en: Choose one JTA result and compare its a, e, i, and element epoch with Jupiter’s orbit.
prompt.zh: 选择一个 JTA 结果，把其 a、e、i 与根数历元同木星轨道比较。

body.en: A traceable object record is the next step from ideal geometry. A long-term stability claim would then require a dedicated perturbed integration.
body.zh: 从理想几何继续研究的下一步是可追溯对象记录；长期稳定性主张还需要专门的受摄积分。

summary.en: Atira, Aten, Apollo, and Amor are geometric orbit classes, not risk scores.
summary.zh: 阿提拉、阿登、阿波罗与阿莫尔是几何轨道分类，并非风险等级。

boundary.en: Orbit class is determined from osculating geometry. It does not encode impact probability, future close approaches, or observational uncertainty.
boundary.zh: 轨道分类来自密切几何，不包含撞击概率、未来近距离接近或观测不确定度。

definition.en: The orbit’s minimum heliocentric distance, a(1−e).
definition.zh: 轨道的最小日心距离，即 a(1−e)。

definition.en: The orbit’s maximum heliocentric distance, a(1+e).
definition.zh: 轨道的最大日心距离，即 a(1+e)。

question.en: Is the Apollo orbit class an impact-risk score?
question.zh: 阿波罗型轨道分类是撞击风险分数吗？

text.en: No, it is an orbital-geometry class
text.zh: 不是，它是轨道几何分类

explanation.en: Risk assessment needs covariance, future perturbations, and continuously updated observations.
explanation.zh: 风险评估需要协方差、未来摄动以及持续更新的观测。

prompt.en: Filter the catalog to all near-Earth classes and inspect q, a, and Q rather than the object’s current distance.
prompt.zh: 筛选全部近地分类，观察 q、a、Q，而不是天体当前距离。

body.en: NEO classes describe the shape and scale of an osculating orbit relative to Earth’s orbit. A member need not be near Earth today.
body.zh: NEO 分类描述密切轨道相对地球轨道的形状与尺度；成员今天未必靠近地球。

prompt.en: Compare orbits whose aphelion stays inside Earth’s orbit with those whose semi-major axis is below 1 AU but cross it.
prompt.zh: 比较远日点始终在地球轨道内的轨道，以及半长轴小于 1 AU 但会穿越地球轨道的轨道。

body.en: Atiras remain interior by aphelion; Atens have a < 1 AU but can extend beyond Earth’s perihelion. The inequalities use orbital elements, not hazard estimates.
body.zh: 阿提拉的远日点位于地球轨道内；阿登的 a < 1 AU，但可延伸到地球近日点之外。这些不等式不是风险估计。

prompt.en: Switch between Apollo and Amor and watch how Earth-crossing versus Earth-approaching geometry changes.
prompt.zh: 在阿波罗与阿莫尔之间切换，观察穿越地球轨道与接近地球轨道的几何差别。

body.en: Apollos have a > 1 AU and perihelia inside Earth’s aphelion; Amors approach from outside but keep perihelia beyond Earth’s aphelion boundary.
body.zh: 阿波罗的 a > 1 AU 且近日点进入地球远日点以内；阿莫尔从外侧接近，但近日点仍在地球远日点边界之外。

prompt.en: Use q–Q element space to compare the class boundaries without relying on object color.
prompt.zh: 使用 q–Q 元素空间比较分类边界，不要只依赖对象颜色。

body.en: The q, Q, and a values make each geometric definition inspectable and accessible in the object table and profile.
body.zh: q、Q 与 a 数值让每个几何定义都可在对象表和档案中直接核验。

prompt.en: Ask which additional evidence would be needed to estimate an impact probability.
prompt.zh: 思考估算撞击概率还需要哪些额外证据。

body.en: Risk work requires covariance, future perturbations, observation updates, and dedicated monitoring. Solar Atlas does not provide collision warnings.
body.zh: 风险分析需要协方差、未来摄动、观测更新与专门监测；Solar Atlas 不提供碰撞预警。

title.en: Follow one object, not a label
title.zh: 继续研究一个对象，而不是标签

prompt.en: Search Bennu or Apophis, open its traceable record, then continue to Events for an explicitly bounded calculation.
prompt.zh: 搜索贝努或阿波菲斯，打开可追溯记录，再进入事件实验室进行有明确边界的计算。

body.en: An object workflow preserves its element epoch and dataset identity. For authoritative approach or risk information, continue to JPL CNEOS/Sentry.
body.zh: 对象工作流会保留根数历元与数据集身份；权威接近或风险信息应继续查阅 JPL CNEOS/Sentry。

title.zh: 保护冥王星的 3:2 共振

summary.en: Pluto crosses Neptune’s orbital radius without close encounters.
summary.zh: 冥王星虽穿过海王星的轨道半径，却通过共振避免近距离相遇。

boundary.en: The plotted two-body ellipses show orbit crossing and approximate timing. They do not prove long-term resonant-angle libration under Neptune’s perturbations.
boundary.zh: 绘制的二体椭圆展示轨道相交与近似节奏，但不能证明海王星摄动下共振角的长期天平动。

definition.en: A combination of orbital longitudes whose bounded behavior diagnoses a resonance.
definition.zh: 由多个轨道经度组合而成、其有界行为可诊断共振的角度。

definition.en: Two bodies share approximately the same heliocentric longitude.
definition.zh: 两个天体具有近似相同日心经度的时刻。

question.en: Is a near-3:2 period ratio by itself enough to prove Pluto’s long-term resonant protection?
question.zh: 周期比接近 3:2，是否足以单独证明冥王星的长期共振保护？

text.en: No, the resonant angle must remain bounded
text.zh: 不足，还要证明共振角保持有界

explanation.en: A dynamical claim follows the resonant angle through a perturbed long-term integration.
explanation.zh: 动力学主张需要在受摄长期积分中跟踪共振角。

title.zh: 轨道相交就一定会相遇吗？

prompt.en: Display Neptune and Pluto in 3D and compare their orbital radii and planes.
prompt.zh: 在三维中显示海王星与冥王星，比较轨道半径和轨道面。

body.en: No. Orbit curves can cross in projection while bodies arrive at the crossing region at different times and heights.
body.zh: 不一定。轨道曲线可在投影中相交，但天体可能在不同时间、不同高度到达交叉区域。

prompt.en: Compare the long trajectory windows: Neptune completes about three revolutions while Pluto completes two.
prompt.zh: 比较长时间轨迹：海王星约完成三圈时，冥王星约完成两圈。

body.en: Their mean motions are close to a 3:2 ratio. Resonant timing constrains the longitudes at which conjunctions recur.
body.zh: 二者平均运动接近 3:2；共振节奏限制了会合重复出现的经度。

prompt.en: Return to 3D and rotate until Pluto’s inclination relative to Neptune’s plane is visible.
prompt.zh: 回到三维并旋转视图，直到冥王星相对海王星轨道面的倾角清晰可见。

body.en: Inclination adds spatial separation near some projected crossings. Timing and three-dimensional geometry both matter.
body.zh: 在部分投影交点附近，倾角会增加空间分离；节奏与三维几何同样重要。

title.zh: 把节奏与轨道交点分开

prompt.en: Move to a conjunction epoch and compare true spatial separation with the crossing orbit curves.
prompt.zh: 移动到一个会合历元，把真实空间间距与相交的轨道曲线比较。

body.en: The curves describe possible positions; the propagated markers add timing. Resonance constrains where repeated conjunctions occur, while inclination adds vertical separation.
body.zh: 曲线描述可能位置，传播后的标记加入时间；共振限制重复会合的位置，倾角则增加垂直分离。

title.zh: 怎样才能证明保护机制？

prompt.en: Separate the visible period ratio from the uncomputed resonant angle.
prompt.zh: 区分画面可见的周期比与尚未计算的共振角。

body.en: A dynamical proof follows a resonant angle such as 3λₚ − 2λₙ − ϖₚ over long N-body integrations. This atlas currently presents a geometric and kinematic explanation only.
body.zh: 动力学证明需要在长期 N-body 积分中跟踪 3λₚ − 2λₙ − ϖₚ 等共振角；本图谱目前只提供几何与运动学说明。

title.zh: 写出缺失的动力学检验

prompt.en: Record the resonant-angle expression and the model upgrade required to evaluate it.
prompt.zh: 记录共振角表达式，以及计算它所需的模型升级。

body.en: A reproducible follow-up would integrate the Sun, giant planets, and Pluto with a validated N-body method, then plot whether 3λₚ − 2λₙ − ϖₚ librates rather than circulates.
body.zh: 可复现的后续研究应使用经验证的 N-body 方法积分太阳、巨行星与冥王星，再绘制 3λₚ − 2λₙ − ϖₚ 是天平动还是周转。

title.en: The road out: Voyager and beyond
title.zh: 离开太阳系：旅行者号之路

summary.en: Separate real mission milestones from a schematic trajectory overlay.
summary.zh: 区分真实任务里程碑与示意轨迹叠加。

boundary.en: Spacecraft tracks interpolate dated mission milestones for teaching. They are not Horizons ephemerides, reconstructed gravity assists, or operational positions.
boundary.zh: 航天器轨迹为教学而插值带日期的任务里程碑，不是 Horizons 星历、重建的引力助推或业务位置。

definition.en: A flyby that exchanges energy and momentum with a moving planet in the heliocentric frame.
definition.zh: 在日心系中通过飞掠移动行星交换能量与动量。

definition.en: Time-indexed positions and velocities from a specified dynamical solution.
definition.zh: 由指定动力学解给出的随时间变化的位置与速度。

question.en: Can the smooth Voyager overlay be used as an operational spacecraft ephemeris?
question.zh: 平滑的旅行者号叠加轨迹能作为业务航天器星历吗？

text.zh: 不能，它只是任务里程碑插值

explanation.en: Current position and navigation work must use mission-team data or JPL Horizons.
explanation.zh: 当前位置与导航工作必须使用任务团队数据或 JPL Horizons。

title.zh: 为什么在 20 世纪 70 年代末发射？

prompt.en: Open the 1977 outer-planet scene and inspect the ordering of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
prompt.zh: 打开 1977 年外行星场景，观察木星、土星、天王星与海王星的排列。

body.en: A rare geometry enabled a chain of encounters, letting one planet redirect the spacecraft toward the next.
body.zh: 罕见的行星几何使连续相遇成为可能，让一颗行星把航天器偏转向下一颗。

prompt.en: Follow the schematic Voyager overlays through their dated giant-planet milestones.
prompt.zh: 沿着旅行者号示意叠加轨迹，追踪带日期的巨行星里程碑。

body.en: A gravity assist changes heliocentric velocity because the spacecraft exchanges momentum with a moving planet during the flyby.
body.zh: 引力助推会改变日心速度，因为航天器在飞掠移动行星时交换动量。

prompt.en: Change the date between milestones and notice the smooth teaching interpolation.
prompt.zh: 把日期移到里程碑之间，观察平滑的教学插值。

body.en: The curve communicates mission sequence and scale. It does not reproduce the reconstructed state vector between encounters.
body.zh: 曲线用于表达任务顺序与尺度，不会重现相遇之间的重建状态向量。

prompt.en: Compare each bend in the teaching path with the dated encounter list rather than treating every interpolated point as a measurement.
prompt.zh: 把教学轨迹中的每次转折同带日期的相遇列表比较，不要把每个插值点当作测量值。

body.en: Dated encounters are the evidence anchors. The connecting curve communicates order and scale, while its source label remains schematic.
body.zh: 带日期的相遇是证据锚点；连接曲线只表达顺序与尺度，并始终标记为示意。

title.zh: 从行星巡游到星际任务

prompt.en: Compare the bounded planetary model with the outward spacecraft teaching path.
prompt.zh: 比较有界的行星模型与向外延伸的航天器教学路径。

body.en: For current spacecraft distance, direction, or navigation, use the mission team and JPL Horizons. Solar Atlas preserves the conceptual story and explicit provenance boundary.
body.zh: 当前航天器距离、方向或导航应使用任务团队与 JPL Horizons 数据；Solar Atlas 只保留概念故事并明确来源边界。

title.en: Compare a concept with a solver
title.zh: 把概念故事同求解器比较

prompt.en: Open Mission Lab and compare a two-body Lambert transfer with the multi-planet flyby sequence.
prompt.zh: 打开任务实验室，把二体 Lambert 转移同多行星飞掠序列比较。

body.en: Lambert solves one heliocentric leg between two endpoint states. Reconstructing Voyager requires patched encounters, launch conditions, targeting constraints, and N-body validation.
body.zh: Lambert 只求解两个端点状态之间的一段日心轨迹；重建旅行者号还需要拼接相遇、发射条件、瞄准约束与 N-body 验证。
